decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch sits close to the core seasonal assortment and uses existing workshop skills, so keeping it costs little and it has likely proven its seasonal demand by now.
The one-tier pyramid fits the established product family and production routines, so the option stays open cheaply even though its distinct value over other pyramids is only moderate.

Several seasons have passed and the flagship music box line remains the firm's main growth option outside the core, so it warrants continued commitment unless clear failure appears, though its distance from the core keeps the risk elevated.

The motif platform is a low-visibility accessory whose value depends on the music box system, so it stays as long as the flagship does, but it is the most likely candidate for pruning now that uncertainty has largely resolved.

The Christmas platform ties the music box to the firm's seasonal strength at low incremental cost, so it is kept for now but remains vulnerable if the platform line does not justify further commitment.
